question: To whom was the teaching transmitted after Nahuṣa?
premises: The teaching was given to Nahuṣa
After that it was given onward
The lunar lineage received it next
inference: The transmission passed from Nahuṣa to the lunar lineage.
uncertainties: The subject who gave the teaching is implicit
plain_english: Then, having given it to Nahuṣa, it was given to the lunar lineage.
